# Community Services Center

> > A nonprofit organization serving the international community in Taiwan for 40 years, offering cultural education, counseling services, and community activities in Taipei.

The Community Services Center provides essential resources for expats and international residents in Taiwan, including practical living guides, cultural education programs, mental health counseling, and community events. The Center hosts activities at venues like Woolloomooloo Xhibit and celebrates Taiwanese culture through initiatives like Through My Eyes.

## Essential Living Guides

- [Guide to Garbage Collection and Recycling in Taipei](https://communitycenter.org.tw/guide-to-garbage-collection-and-recycling-in-taipei): Practical guide to Taipei waste management and recycling for expats

- [Activities](https://communitycenter.org.tw/activities): Main activities page listing classes, events, and community programs

## Cultural Education

- [What is Tomb Sweeping Day in Taiwan?](https://communitycenter.org.tw/what-is-tomb-sweeping-day-in-taiwan): Explains Tomb Sweeping Day (Qingming Festival) traditions in Taiwan

## Counseling & Mental Health

- [Miranda Yi-Chun Lin 林怡君](https://communitycenter.org.tw/miranda-yi-chun-lin-%e6%9e%97%e6%80%a1%e5%90%9b): Profile of bilingual counseling psychologist Miranda Yi-Chun Lin

## Optional

- [2026-04-23 Exploring A Local Tea Farm](https://communitycenter.org.tw/events/2026-04-23-exploring-a-local-tea-farm): Tea farm day trip led by Yasuko Hondo from Xindian MRT Station
- [2026-03-15: 週末，與克華的詩與人生故事相遇](https://communitycenter.org.tw/events/2026-03-15-%e9%80%b1%e6%9c%ab%ef%bc%8c%e8%88%87%e5%85%8b%e8%8f%af%e7%9a%84%e8%a9%a9%e8%88%87%e4%ba%ba%e7%94%9f%e6%95%85%e4%ba%8b%e7%9b%b8%e9%81%87): Poetry and life stories event with Ko-Hua Chen at Woolloomooloo Xhibit
- [2026-03-18: 當霸凌留下看不見的傷痕：理解與支持青少年的心理健康 – 中文](https://communitycenter.org.tw/events/2026-03-18-when-bullying-leaves-invisible-wounds-understanding-and-supporting-adolescents-mental-health): Chinese workshop on bullying and adolescent mental health in Taipei
- [2026-03-14: 什麼是諮商？適合我嗎？一場溫柔的入門分享 – 中文](https://communitycenter.org.tw/events/2026-03-14-what-is-counseling-chinese): Chinese intro to counseling basics at Woolloomooloo Xhibit
- [2026-03-14: Introduction to Breath-Supported Vinyasa Yoga – English](https://communitycenter.org.tw/events/2026-03-14-a-mindful-yoga-experience-with-den-yoga): Free beginner Vinyasa yoga workshop with Den Yoga at Woolloomooloo
- [Tom Rook Archives](https://communitycenter.org.tw/brand/tom-rook): Archive of Tom Rook's walking tours in Dadaocheng and Taiwan history
- [Chen-Chun Lin Archives](https://communitycenter.org.tw/brand/chen-chun-lin): Archive of counselor Chen-Chun Lin's family therapy and teen workshops
